paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文提出 Vision Transformer（ViT），将图像切分为固定大小的 patch 序列，直接送入标准 Transformer 编码器进行图像分类，几乎不引入图像特有的归纳偏置 [S1.p3][S5.p1]。作者发现，在中等规模数据集（如 ImageNet）上训练时 ViT 略逊于同规模 ResNet，但在大规模数据（14M–300M 图像）上预训练后迁移到多个基准时，ViT 可达到或超过当时最优卷积网络，且预训练所需计算资源显著更少 [S1.p4][S1.p5][S4.SS2.p2]。论文还通过预训练数据规模、模型规模与计算量的对照实验，以及注意力可视化，分析了 ViT 的数据需求与内部表示 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p2][S4.SS5.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，把标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，以及此前将自注意力用于视觉时因专用注意力模式而难以在现代硬件上有效扩展 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Self-attention-based architectures, in particular Transformers, have become the model of choice in natural language processing (NLP).
In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
The latter models, while theoretically efficient, have not yet been scaled effectively on modern hardware accelerators due to the use of specialized attention patterns.
Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.

method.text: 方法上，ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的 patch，对每个 patch 做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.F1]。模型沿用 BERT 式的可学习 [class] token 作为图像表示，并在预训练和微调时在其输出上接分类头 [S3.SS1.p2]。ViT 刻意保持设计简单，只保留最少的图像特有归纳偏置，二维结构仅在切 patch 和微调时调整位置嵌入等环节被手动注入 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
To handle 2D images, we reshape the image into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
We note that Vision Transformer has much less image-specific inductive bias than CNNs.
Note that this resolution adjustment and patch extraction are the only points at which an inductive bias about the 2D structure of the images is manually injected

experiments.text: 实验在 ImageNet（1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（14M 图像）和 JFT-300M（303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Pets、Flowers-102 以及 19 项 VTAB 分类套件等基准 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。模型配置基于 BERT 的 Base/Large 并新增 Huge，用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与 patch 大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。对照基线包括改用 Group Normalization 的 ResNet（BiT）以及将 CNN 特征图送入 Transformer 的混合模型 [S4.SS1.p4]。此外还进行了预训练数据规模实验、JFT-300M 上的受控规模研究，以及初步的自监督掩码 patch 预测实验 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p1][S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images
We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
First, we pre-train ViT models on datasets of increasing size: ImageNet, ImageNet-21k, and JFT-300M.
We perform a controlled scaling study of different models by evaluating transfer performance from JFT-300M.
We also perform a preliminary exploration on masked patch prediction for self-supervision

findings.text: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后，较小的 ViT-L/16 在所有任务上超过同样预训练的 BiT-L，且训练计算资源显著更少；更大的 ViT-H/14 进一步提升性能，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。在预训练数据规模实验中，ViT 在较小数据集上不如 BiT ResNet，但随着数据增大反超，且更大的 ViT 变体随数据增长才显现优势 [S4.SS3.p2]。受控规模研究表明，ViT 在性能/计算权衡上优于 ResNet，约用 2–4 倍更少计算达到相同性能，混合模型在小计算预算下略优但差距随模型增大消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。注意力分析显示，部分注意力头在最低层就关注整幅图像，注意力距离随网络深度增加，模型关注与分类语义相关的区域 [S4.SS5.p3]。

evidence.quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks
The larger model, ViT-H/14, further improves the performance, especially on the more challenging datasets
The BiT CNNs outperform ViT on ImageNet, but with the larger datasets, ViT overtakes.
First, Vision Transformers dominate ResNets on the performance/compute trade-off.
ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance
Second, hybrids slightly outperform ViT at small computational budgets, but the difference vanishes for larger models.
We find that some heads attend to most of the image already in the lowest layers
Further, the attention distance increases with network depth.
Globally, we find that the model attends to image regions that are semantically relevant for classification

limitations.text: 作者指出，ViT 在中等规模数据集（如 ImageNet）上无强正则时精度比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。自监督预训练虽有提升，但 ViT-B/16 仍比监督预训练低 4%，自监督与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S4.SS6.p1][S5.p2]。作者还提出将 ViT 应用于检测、分割等其他视觉任务，以及继续探索自监督预训练，都是尚待解决的挑战 [S5.p2]。

evidence.quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality
but still 4% behind supervised pre-training
One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
Another challenge is to continue exploring self-supervised pre-training methods.
but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training
